summary: PASS for bounded, native source-preserving A1–A7 repairs subject to stated acceptance. Static review completed; implementation and runtime acceptance belong to root and remain unverified. Preserve approved reference artwork, handed structural geometry and historical receipts. Hanafuda remains a separate approved-but-pending integration. Digital repairs do not establish electrical, firmware or physical product completion.

findings.claim: Reviewed the enumerated snapshot recorded as clean commit b3e44990d9272327fef042439f1a6555eaae8c4f. Confidence: high for A1–A4/A6 source diagnoses; medium for exact diode installation and presentation details.
evidence: build/audit-fixes-20261007/baseline.json records commit, status and artifact hashes.
Only enumerated artifacts were read; no mutations, tests, product execution, network effects or subdelegation occurred.
Native geometry, PCB files and presentation assets were outside this review's readable scope. Different current hashes, geometry or package identity would require renewed comparison.

findings.claim: Bind display mating members and clearance tools to one DisplayShiftY delta, preserving separate PCB-fixed socket Z and DisplayBottom-relative removable-member Z.
evidence: level_stack.py:183–226 binds visuals/window Y but leaves socket, spacer, contacts, solder, relief and service-well Y fixed.
Retain install_display_seam.py:40 corrected window expression using -46.55 mm; native sled and drill dependencies already exist in build_revI.py.

Acceptance: both halves, DisplayShiftY 2.4→3.4 produces -1 mm Y movement throughout the chain, unchanged relative mating positions and intended Z, no glass collision, and successful save/reopen. KiCad footprints/nets/tracks remain unchanged.
An intentionally fixed service region requires explicit datum evidence before exclusion.

findings.claim: Keep approved paths fixed in case XY; intersect color volumes with the current structural blank through native Boolean dependencies before subtracting their union from the body.
evidence: approved_frames.py:89–130 uses fixed apertures and directly fuses color extrusions; flush_frames.py supplies native Common/Cut patterns.

Acceptance: both halves/all supported active styles, reference and edited states: bidirectional blank/union difference below 1e-5 mm³, disjoint interiors, connected structural body, closed meshes and no glass intersection.
Reference top regions must match frozen approval within 0.002 mm². Edited regions must match explicitly clipped reference artwork, recording clipping/body-colored fill.
Export-only clipping or replacing the union with the blank conceals native defects. If motifs must remain intact, reject incompatible edits.

findings.claim: Make ordinary inlay floors roof-relative; verify actual backing. Preserve distinct collar/header-cover construction and derive moving zones from actual relief/service geometry.
evidence: approved_frames.py:115–121 fixes floors while extrusion height grows; its validator hardcodes roof 13.59 and fixed floors.
export_revI.py distinguishes ordinary backing 1.0 mm, through-color collar 0.865 mm and header cover 0.4 mm.
Acceptance: FrameTop 13.59→13.99 retains ordinary depth 0.4 mm and actual backing at least 0.8 mm using section or lower-face probes; baseline zone solids remain unchanged.
Test collar/cover interfaces separately, including moved display zones. Through-color collar floor should follow the actual relief ceiling; a blanket backing rule would alter approved construction.
Reject incompatible edits. Native sections establishing different approved relationships would change collar/cover formulas.

findings.claim: Apply the smallest local native cut clearing the existing nominal USB corridor, and check every base, plate and frame on both halves.
evidence: export_revI.py checks its 12×20×5 mm corridor only against frames; the audit reports 3.120 mm³ interference in every base at Z6.10–6.30.
Reuse shared tray construction where appropriate, while checking added variant geometry.
Acceptance: corridor intersections below established tolerance, single-solid cases, closed meshes and all geometry changes confined to the intended access region; mounts remain unchanged.
If MCU movement is supported, corridor and cut must follow its datum. Purchased-cable geometry may require later clearance changes; nominal repair does not qualify every cable.

findings.claim: Install 36 pinned SOD-123 instances using current footprint references, poses and B.Cu layers; add calibrated native/PCB registration and collision coverage.
evidence: sources.json pins D_SOD-123.step; export_pcb_components.py has calibrated bottom transforms but omits diodes.
sync_pcb_study.py resets historical revF placement/connectivity and clears models; do not use it for this repair.

Acceptance: exactly 18 expected unique refs per half, verified source hash, closed geometry, actual KiCad STEP/native registration and unchanged electrical/footprint state except intended model references.
Check PCB, every base, sockets and access; report minimum floor clearance and collisions.
Unqualified hot-swap registration leaves that comparison unresolved. Package mismatch, hash failure, registration differences or collisions change the recommendation.

findings.claim: Repair stale assertions, add meaningful parameter/save-reopen coverage and make the aggregate audit fail when required children fail.
evidence: check_revI.py assumes legacy Level, battery Z2 and validates edited frames mainly by ZMax; current contracts are legacy Solid and battery Z1.4.
The audit records retired HEX selector handheld and stale roof expectations. audit_parameters.py probes only left Talavera; audit_current.py records failures without a failing aggregate exit.
Acceptance: current Game Boy/current roof expectations, independent legacy normalization and battery assertions, mixed roundtrip, negative inputs, both-half/style edit coverage and one combined edit.
Validate geometry invariants after save/reopen and restoration. Inject a failing child to verify aggregate failure; retain unrouted findings and historical receipts.

findings.claim: Align current dimensions, macro-visible naming/export defaults and hero to Flan36/Talavera; preserve historical identifiers and collections.
evidence: The audit identifies stale roof/margin, Filo36 dialogs and retired Flan hero; docs/freecad.md states current 1.4 mm roof and 0.10 mm margin.
Acceptance: source-matched dimensions, inspected current imagery, correct current labels and working macro export/roundtrip without indiscriminate legacy renaming.

approved-viewer-selection.md identifies five active designs and Hanafuda pending integration. No Hanafuda geometry/approval artifacts were reviewed; its integration requires a separate supported decision.

recommendations: Proceed with preserved-candidate native repairs and execute each finding's acceptance before replacing reference artifacts.
Close findings individually with current input hashes and measured results; any unresolved required repair keeps A1–A7 partial.
Keep routing, integrated firmware, purchased-part fit and physical qualification distinct from digital repair acceptance.

validations.name: Independent recommendation and falsifiable acceptance criteria
